topic: How a multi-branch operation manages payroll for four locations from one screen
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
One finance manager. Four branches. Three days lost every month just figuring out why one branch made the whole payroll cycle slip.

After SmartPRO Hub: one screen, one payroll run, all four locations processed together. WPS files sent directly to the bank. SPF contributions calculated automatically. Omanization ratios verified before submission.

Same company. Same team. Half the time.

Multi-branch payroll in Oman has a problem most owners don't say out loud. Every location runs a little differently. Headcounts shift. Overtime varies. One branch manager submits late and the whole cycle slips — and then someone in finance spends three days chasing down why.

SmartPRO Hub puts it all in one place. Every employee, every branch, one dashboard. WPS compliance, Ministry of Labour filings, and SPF calculations are built in. No exporting to another tool. No re-entering data someone already typed somewhere else. No 9pm calls the night before salary day.

We built it this way because fragmented tools push accountability into the gaps between them. In payroll, that's where the money goes.

If your finance team is still manually stitching branch payrolls together each month, that's the first thing worth fixing.
